task: One clean Flow receiver plate for the returning reply. No Kling, lip sync, or baked musical effects.

proposed_cut.approval: timing proposal for next review, production shotlist unchanged

polling.progress_estimate: With increasing percent, estimate remaining=(100-current)/(percent gain/elapsed seconds). Next check=max(10,min(20,0.5*estimated remaining)). Percent is approximate; default20 if unusable.
polling.exceptions: Honor explicit rate limits and retry-after. Tool latency counts as waiting. No overlapping checks. No resubmission for unchanged status.
polling.stalled_job: At15 minutes pending report status to owner, keep20-30s checks if tools allow; explicit service errors require stopping and reporting, never automatic retry.

codex_post.rosettes: Carry the approved cyan/amber duet across cut; match outgoing motion and phase, no second birth animation. Arrive in peripheral space and settle into loose orbits near the receiver. No hand sorting or tidy puzzle resolution.
codex_post.receiver: Fresh vocal-envelope analysis at song1090..1201; same +0.178348 stem placement applied once. Re-track new plate; never reuse old homographies or baked response from Tell me what you got.
codex_post.assembly: Shared source resolver and timestamp conform. Master audio and lyrics once. Review preceding astronaut plus this shot before promotion.

coverage_guard: Report measured native timestamps, fps, frame count and actual usable range. Must cover source131/24 seconds. Do not infer handles from requested duration.
continuity_guard: Use only the approved B still as first frame, no end frame and no extracted video frame. Do not widen or invent observatory interior. Matching device insert implies reply connection, not a proven spatial camera match.

claude_result.content_check: receiver/background stable; no people, hands, props, rosettes, lights, flashes, cuts or freezes; meters steady
